Dr Ronen Gold has specialised successfully in urogynaecology for more than 20 years, helping thousands of patients at Israel's largest medical centres. His practice covers a wide range of problems of the female urinary and genital system, such as urinary incontinence, inflammatory conditions of the urinary tract, prolapse of the uterus and other organs, vaginal dryness, and tears of the anal sphincter after childbirth. He is also a sought-after specialist in plastic and aesthetic gynaecological surgery.

Principal achievements and methods:

  • Official representative in Israel of the manufacturer of the innovative non-surgical laser technology FemiLift.
  • Expert in the use of FemiLift, which allows the vagina to be tightened without surgery and treats dryness and urinary incontinence.

Dr Gold regularly receives appreciative feedback from hundreds of grateful patients for his professionalism, the clarity of his explanations and his tact.

The doctor's areas of interest:

  • Overactive bladder.
  • Stress urinary incontinence.
  • Recurrent urinary tract infections.
  • Pelvic organ prolapse.
  • Prolapse of the uterus.
  • Laser treatment of urinary incontinence.
  • Treatment of complications after childbirth.

Procedures the doctor performs:

  • Aesthetic gynaecological operations.
  • Laparoscopic surgery.
  • Vaginal reconstruction and aesthetics.
  • All techniques of urogynaecology and pelvic floor surgery.

Education and fellowships:

  • Medical degree from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Tel Aviv University.
  • Fellowship in urogynaecology at the Tel Aviv medical centre.
  • Training in laparoscopic methods at St George's Hospital, London.
  • Fellowship at the European College of Aesthetic Medicine and Surgery.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Association of Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
  • European College of Aesthetic Medicine and Surgery (ECAMS).
  • Israel Urogynaecology Society.
  • International Urogynecological Association (IUGA).
  • International Continence Society (ICS).

Dr Roni Rachmiel is a well-known Israeli ophthalmic surgeon who has spent more than 20 years on the diagnosis and treatment of eye disorders, and of uveitis and glaucoma in particular.

Key areas of work:

  • Treatment of age-related eye disease
  • Congenital abnormalities
  • Mechanical injury to the eyeball and others

Treatment methods:

  1. Conservative approaches
  2. Radical methods, including:
  • Microsurgical techniques
  • Laser therapy
  • Other innovative methods

Innovations in the treatment of glaucoma:

  • Development of a minimally invasive treatment method
  • No post-operative complications
  • The shortest possible recovery

Education and clinical practice:

  • Degree from Tel Aviv University
  • Specialisation at the Kaplan clinic
  • Fellowship at a Toronto clinic (Canada), with training in the laser treatment of glaucoma

Research and teaching:

  • Author of papers on the diagnosis and treatment of glaucoma
  • Publications in leading medical journals
  • Teaching in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University (course in eye microsurgery)

Membership of professional organisations:

  • International association of ophthalmologists
  • Israel Ophthalmological Society

Professor Sami Viskin is a leader in electrophysiology and interventional cardiology and head of a cardiac inpatient department. His professional career is striking evidence of his deep understanding and skill in interventional cardiology.

Professor Viskin uses modern diagnostic methods to investigate cardiac arrhythmias, including Holter monitoring, ECG and exercise testing, which makes him one of the leading experts in this field. His diagnostic approach covers both minimally invasive and non-invasive methods, ensuring a thorough examination of the patient.

Professor Viskin also shows outstanding skill in cardiac catheterisation, which allows him to work successfully within the structures of the heart for treatment and diagnosis. His experience in fitting pacemakers makes him a specialist to whom many colleagues turn for advice and help.

His expertise in ablation deserves particular mention. This treatment, which involves eliminating abnormal electrical pathways in the heart, can be complex, but in Professor Viskin's hands it becomes highly effective and safe.

In sum, Professor Sami Viskin is not only an eminent specialist in his field but one who devotes his knowledge and experience to improving his patients' quality of life, applying advanced techniques and innovative approaches in cardiology.

Erwin Santo is a leading gastroenterologist with more than 40 years of professional experience. His continuous work and research in gastroenterology have made him a key figure in the medical world, particularly in endoscopy.

Dr Santo heads the endoscopy unit in the gastroenterology department of Ichilov, one of the leading medical centres. His unit provides high-quality diagnosis and treatment using the latest advances in endoscopic technology.

In 2021 Dr Santo's talent and efforts received great recognition when he was included in the list of the year's best doctors by the respected Israeli magazine Forbes Israel. This confirms his standing not only as a doctor but as a professional making a substantial contribution to the advance of medicine.

EDUCATION

Faculty of medicine, Rappaport research centre at the Technion, Haifa

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association (since 2010).
  • Honorary member of the American Society for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy.
  • Founder of the EuroEUS group.
  • Member of the Israel Association for the Study of the Liver

Professor Shimon Rochkind: a leading neurosurgeon in Israel

Specialisation:
Professor Shimon Rochkind is known for his expertise in minimally invasive endoscopic surgery of the peripheral nerves and in the repair of the nerve fibres of the brachial plexus, and for his deep knowledge of paediatric neurosurgery and the use of laser technologies.

Education and clinical experience:

  • Residency and fellowships at the Sourasky centre, Tel Aviv; the Rambam medical centre, Haifa; and the hospital in Ivano-Frankivsk, Ukraine.
  • Specialisation in surgery of the brachial plexus and peripheral nerves at Groote Schuur Hospital, Cape Town, South Africa; the children's hospital in Toronto, Canada; the Oguri Daihachi clinic, Japan; and the Carl Gustav Carus University Hospital, Dresden, Germany.

Academic and research work:
He took his degree at the Ivano-Frankivsk medical institute and then continued his specialisation in neurosurgery. He is actively engaged in research and has published more than 120 papers.

Membership of medical associations:

  • Executive committee of the World Federation of Neurosurgical Societies.
  • Israel association of laser neurosurgery.
  • International committee for peripheral nerve repair.

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Heart failure
  • Arrhythmias
  • Atherosclerosis
  • Heart defects in children
  • Coronary artery disease
  • Aortic stenosis
  • Myocardial hypertrophy
  • Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
  • Heart valve replacement
  • Coronary artery bypass grafting
  • Coronary angioplasty, stenting
  • Coronary angiography

Professor Shmuel Banai is an outstanding researcher and specialist in innovative methods of diagnosing and treating cardiovascular disease, and the author of more than 150 research publications.

He shows excellent skill in performing both diagnostic and therapeutic cardiac catheterisation. In his hands diagnostic catheterisation successfully identifies congenital heart defects, valve problems, blockages in the vessels and other cardiac abnormalities. Professor Banai performs procedures such as aortic valve replacement, stenting and the prevention of thrombosis with exceptional precision.

Since beginning his medical career in 1984, Professor Banai has helped thousands of patients, applying the newest methods of cardiovascular medicine in practice. His experience and knowledge were formed during a three-year fellowship in the United States and over many years of service in Israel, where he began his career as a senior cardiologist and later became deputy head of a cardiology department.

As a respected teacher at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Professor Banai was named best teacher in 1992, 1994, 1995, 2004 and 2005.

Education

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Professional experience as a military doctor with a tank brigade in the Israel Defence Forces
  • Specialisation in cardiovascular research at the laboratory of experimental physiology and pharmacology, National Institutes of Health, Maryland, USA
  • Specialisation in cardiology and internal medicine at the Bikur Holim hospital in Jerusalem, Israel

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Heart Society
  • European Association for Cardio-Thoracic Surgery

Professor Shmuel Dekel headed the orthopaedic departments of Israel's largest medical centres, Ichilov and Soroka among them, for many years. He is a doctor with more than 30 years of experience and the author of more than 100 research papers.

Professor Dekel was named best teacher in the faculty of medicine at the University of Oxford and best teacher of medicine at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel.

Specialisation:

  • Orthopaedics;
  • Knee replacement;
  • Hip replacement;
  • Knee arthroplasty;
  • Hip arthroplasty;
  • Complex and revision joint operations;
  • Surgical treatment of a wide range of problems of the kneecap.

Conditions treated:

  • Osteoarthritis of the hip;
  • Joint disease;
  • Coxarthrosis of the hip;
  • Destruction of the hip joint;
  • Hip injury;
  • Arthroscopy of the hip;
  • Joint replacement. Arthroplasty and arthroscopy.

Education and experience:

  • Graduated from the faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University;
  • Fellowship in orthopaedics at the Ichilov medical centre;
  • Took a doctoral degree in medicine, lectured in medicine and operated at the Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre, Oxford, the largest orthopaedic centre in Europe;
  • Head of orthopaedic department no. 2;
  • Chairman of the Israel Orthopaedic Association.

Membership of professional associations:

  • Israel Orthopaedic Association;
  • British Orthopaedic Research Society;
  • Girdlestone Orthopaedic Society;
  • British Orthopaedic Association (Overseas Fellow);
  • International Society for Fracture Repair.
